Under Florida law, candidates names had to appear to the left with associated check boxes (or equivalent) to the right. The order of candidates is mandated that the first name is the candidate whose party won the most recent gubernatorial election, with others in descending order matching that vote tally. Since Florida had a Republican governor, Bush’s name was supposed to be first with his punch box to the right, and the second name and second box were supposed to be for Gore. Instead, Gore’s name was in the number 2 position but his punch box was in the number 3 position with Pat Buchanan’s name to the right of the second box.
